Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: Activities, Molecule Dictionary, Compound Structures. Join: Activities to Molecule Dictionary via molregno. Molecule Dictionary to Compound Structures via molregno. Filter: assay_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054500', standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
